title: VOW-TAKEN log line
description: Schema for one VOW-TAKEN line printed to Output and appended to the ledger row (DEATH-CAPS precedent), per the Third Way Initiation playtest addendum. Canonical format: VOW-TAKEN seat=<name> t=<mm:ss> vow=<id> price=<vm> improbable_spent=<n> seed=peeked|unpeeked. The vow value must be an id from THIRD_WAY_BOONS_STUB.json. Sibling GRACE lines (t, d1, d2, total, pass) are a separate schema, owed, not defined here.

event.description: literal line discriminator, DEATH-CAPS precedent: the event name speaks in caps

seat.description: the seat taking the Vow (NPC=SEAT law: every NPC is a seat); printed as <name> in the line

t.description: session clock at Vow time, mm:ss, matching the 20-minute playtest beats (0-3 Act I, 3-8 war loop, 8-12 Wall, 12-15 Door, 15-20 Act III)

vow.description: boon id sworn on; must match an id in watch/inbox/THIRD_WAY_BOONS_STUB.json; Unstuck-face ids (crits, longer_superhot) are vow_eligible=false and must never appear here

price.description: VM paid for the Vow; stub pricing is 2x the boon's vm_cost, per the Inefficiency Law (F6: no optimization path may exist)

improbable_spent.description: Improbability resource consumed by the grace shrine at Vow time; the Drive rents, it does not gift

seed_mode.description: session seed mode at Vow time; printed as seed=peeked|unpeeked. Unpeeked means every grace roll rides the pure 2d6 curve (pass on 7, 15/36) with no marble bags, hidden rerolls, or streak breakers; any divergence between two same-seed runs voids the Unpeeked Seed claim
